info.title: SdkGenerator
info.description:
A command line dotnet tool to retrieve swagger (OpenAPI) files and generate
      easy-to-use markdown documentation or friendly software development kit libraries. Can be
      automated using Github Workflows.

commands.name: compare
commands.description: Compare one swagger file to another

options.name: --old
options.description: Path or URL to the current swagger file

options.name: --new
options.description: Path or URL to the pre-release swagger file

options.name: --slack
options.description: Endpoint to share the diff via Slack

options.name: --log
options.description: Write errors to a log file on disk. If null, writes to stdout

options.name: --template
options.description: To build only one single template, specify this option

options.name: --file
options.description: Use a specific OpenAPI/Swagger file and do not attempt to download from source

options.name: --generate-if-minor
options.description: Still generate SDK even if changes are minor

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a new template file for a new SDK

options.name: --log
options.description: Write errors to a log file on disk. If null, writes to stdout

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Report on differences from previous swagger file

options.name: --log
options.description: Write errors to a log file on disk. If null, writes to stdout

options.name: --old
options.description: Path to the older version of the swagger file

commands.name: complete-patch-notes
commands.description: Create unified patch notes for all swagger files in a folder

options.name: --folder
options.description: Path to the folder containing swagger files

options.name: --patch-notes
options.description: The file name for the comprehensive patch notes file

options.name: --dates-file
options.description: A JSON file containing dates for each swagger version

options.name: --host
options.description: The host name of the site where documentation is hosted

options.name: --link-format
options.description: The format of links to use ('None', 'Fern')

commands.name: get-patch-notes
commands.description: Get patch notes in Markdown for the current build

options.name: --log
options.description: Write errors to a log file on disk. If null, writes to stdout

commands.name: get-release-name
commands.description: Get the release name for the current build

options.name: --log
options.description: Write errors to a log file on disk. If null, writes to stdout
